faqs.question: Who is Chum and where are they based?
faqs.answer: Chum is a San Francisco Bay Area Phish tribute band founded in 2010. As one of the longest-running Phish tribute acts in the United States, the band performs across Northern California and the West Coast.

faqs.question: Who are the members of Chum?
faqs.answer: Chum's lineup features Eric Ingersoll (keyboards and vocals), Chris Detrick (guitar and vocals), Chad Kimner (bass and vocals), and Alex Bowman (drums and vocals), with occasional guest appearances on guitar by Eric Schiff. The band also honors the memory of keyboardist and vocalist John Greene (2014–2025).

faqs.question: Where can I listen to live recordings of Chum?
faqs.answer: More than 47 full live concert recordings of Chum are available to stream and download for free on the Internet Archive's Live Music Archive (https://archive.org/details/ChumATributeToPhish) and directly through the audio player on chumphishtribute.com.

faqs.question: How do I book Chum for a venue, festival, or private event?
faqs.answer: For booking inquiries, contact No Brainer Productions at nobrainerproductions831@gmail.com. For general band inquiries, email chumphishtribute@gmail.com.
